description: This Kotlin source file implements a repository class for handling user news resources by combining news data with user data repositories. It provides methods to observe all news resources, news resources for followed topics, and bookmarked news resources, using Kotlin coroutines Flow for reactive data handling.

classes.name: CompositeUserNewsResourceRepository
classes.description: A repository class that combines news resources with user data to provide reactive flows of user-specific news resource data.

methods.name: observeAll
methods.description: Returns a Flow of UserNewsResource lists filtered by a query, combining news data with user data.

methods.name: observeAllForFollowedTopics
methods.description: Returns a Flow of UserNewsResource lists for topics followed by the user, updating reactively when followed topics change.

methods.name: observeAllBookmarked
methods.description: Returns a Flow of UserNewsResource lists that are bookmarked by the user, updating reactively when bookmarks change.
